capabilities.scope: Applies to eMMC-equipped variants only; the cited specimen has 4 GiB RAM and nominal 64 GB eMMC. UEFI/ACPI boot and warm reboot passed for pinned bundles, not every later kernel or Lite variant.

Applies to wireless variants only; the cited specimen uses CYW43455. WPA2 and SAE/H2E with required PMF have bounded transfer checks. Non-wireless variants, long runs and general throughput are not covered.
V3D render and compute checks exist. Complete accelerated Plasma and general recovery are not accepted by this source.
Connector availability does not establish a working application or pin configuration.
One Generic four-wire PWM fan on CM5-NANO-B passed the recorded minimum-level scenario and policy persistence after reboot. Other fans, cold starts and long runs need separate checks.
